name: Rindou Nao
source:
Tooru's classmate and close female friend. Handy but handsy, and a little too free with hugs. Info-dump about the wildest things unprompted. 

(From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361760/Real_Anime_Situation_2/]Steam page[/url])

Likes: Her [url=/c88025]mother's[/url] cooking, eating
Dislikes: Fish dishes, studying
